question: How many employees did Etsy announce it was laying off in August 2026?

hits.title: Etsy cuts 12% of workforce days after $1.4 billion Depop sale.
hits.snippet: Etsy is restructuring its business and cutting around 200 jobs just days after receiving $1.4 billion from the sale of its Depop marketplace to eBay, creating a striking contrast between the company's fresh cash injection and its decision to reduce its workforce.

hits.title: Etsy, Amazon, eBay, and Shopify in April: analyzing the significant divergence in e-commerce stock performance.
hits.snippet: * Etsy (ETSY) stock surged 29% in April following a report of Q1 revenue amounting to $631 million, exceeding projections by $13.7 million.

hits.title: Etsy to cut 220 jobs as CEO reshapes organisation.
hits.snippet: The restructuring comes as Etsy continues to sharpen its focus on its core handmade and artisanal marketplace while competing with major e-commerce players such as Amazon, Walmart, TikTok Shop and Temu.

hits.title: Etsy lays off 12% of workforce as part of restructuring plan.
hits.snippet: NEW YORK, NY, Aug 5: Crafting marketplace Etsy Inc. is laying off approximately 220 employees, or 12 per cent of its workforce, as part of a restructuring plan it hopes will "improve coordination and speed of decision-making," the company said in a U.S. Securities and Exchange Commission filing on Wednesday.

hits.title: Etsy's New Global Shipping Option Reduces Reliance on USPS
hits.snippet: Etsy partnered with an Asendia affiliated company to offer the Etsy Global Postal Shipping program, which Etsy said includes an affordable international shipping option that uses First Class International Parcel services.

hits.title: eBay to operate Depop as it seeks synergies.
hits.snippet: Goyal moved back from Depop to become President of Etsy in December 2024 and changed roles again this year, replacing former Etsy CEO Josh Silverman on January 1, 2026.
